summary: Iteration 3 for Telugu POS 'ఉష కిరాణా'. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass — added coverage for stock set/add, bill-decrements-stock, monthly report shape+per_day, monthly customer statement (opening+billed-paid==closing), duplicate shortcut code 400 with Telugu message. Frontend: monthly report (matrix, day totals, search, print) works; Khata statement print renders #print-area with 'ఖాతా స్టేట్‌మెంట్' and opening/billed/paid/closing (window.print overridden); Billing code-edit toggle works — duplicate 'a1'->'b1' is rejected with Telugu toast "'b1' కోడ్ ఇప్పటికే బియ్యం (సోనా మసూరి) కి ఉంది" and a1 remains; successful rename a1->z9 persists and reverts cleanly; Settings shows printer-help block, 5 ui-scale buttons + receipt-font slider. Mobile /month matrix renders. FOUND 1 CRITICAL frontend regression: Items.jsx blurring the item-code cell throws ReferenceError 'saveCode is not defined' and shows a full-page red webpack-dev error overlay that blocks all interactions on /items.

ui_bugs.issue: onBlur calls saveCode(it, e.target.value) but no such function is defined in Items.jsx (saveCode only exists in Billing.jsx). Any blur with a changed value throws 'ReferenceError: saveCode is not defined' — captured via page.on('pageerror') and shown as a red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay that intercepts pointer events, breaking the whole /items page. Repro: /items → change value in item-code-a3 input → Tab → red error overlay appears.

On mobile viewport /month the body itself horizontally overflows (body.scrollWidth=478 vs clientWidth=390). The matrix container has overflow-auto but its parent card row is being stretched by the wide table so page-level horizontal scroll appears. Not a crash, but the header/side chrome shifts. Wrap the matrix card in a min-w-0 flex parent or set overflow-x-hidden on the outer container.

action_items: URGENT: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Items.jsx add a saveCode function (mirror of Billing.jsx line 22-32) that calls api.updateItem(it.id, { ...it, code: newCode }) with try/catch that surfaces backend's Telugu duplicate-code detail via toast.error, then reloads items. This unblocks the 'custom shortcut codes editable' feature on the Items page.
MonthReport.jsx mobile: constrain outer wrapper so table scroll is contained; add min-w-0 to the flex/grid child holding the matrix card.
critical_code_review_comments: Items.jsx: onBlur handler references undefined function (saveCode) — must be caught by lint/typescheck. Consider adding CI ESLint no-undef enforcement so this doesn't ship.
Items.jsx: even after fix, savePrice/saveStock have no try/catch — a failing PUT (e.g. backend 400) will silently succeed-toast; wrap in try/catch (same as Billing.saveCode).
MonthReport.jsx: `!q || i.code.includes(q.toLowerCase()) || i.name_te.includes(q)` — for Telugu names uses raw q, for code uses lowercased q. Consistent — OK. But no substring highlighting; minor UX.
server.py list_bills date range still uses tz-less string boundaries against tz-aware ISO strings — carried over from prev iterations; small edge risk around UTC midnight.

server.py update_stock: when both set_stock and add are supplied, set_stock is applied first then add is added — matches spec but not documented; consider Pydantic validator to reject both together for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — Items page blocked by saveCode ReferenceError; every other page verified working

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed invoked in pytest session and on Billing mount. New backend tests also seed extra bills/khata txns for stock/monthly/statement coverage — safe, uses seeded items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest covers 18 tests including new monthly-report per_day matrix, statement math, stock+auto-decrement, duplicate-code rejection. To retest Items.jsx after fix: log in via [data-testid=login-*], navigate [data-testid=nav-items], change [data-testid=item-code-a3] input to 'a3z' and Tab — expect no page-level red error overlay, expect item-code-a3z present, revert. Always add init script overriding window.print (Khata + MonthReport + Billing all call it). Bearer token accepted; frontend also stores it in localStorage under 'token'. Customer buttons use data-testid=customer-<uuid>.
